license: NASA open data (free, attribution requested); see GES DISC data policy
attribution: Huffman, G.J., E.F. Stocker, D.T. Bolvin, E.J. Nelkin, Jackson Tan (2023), GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 day 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07, Greenbelt, MD, Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC).
spatial_resolution: 0.1 degree (~10 km), units: mm accumulated; nodata -9999
limitations: Satellite-based estimate on a ~10 km (0.1 degree) grid; not a rain-gauge measurement
Final Run is gauge-adjusted at monthly scale; daily values carry substantial error in intense convective/cyclonic rain
Daily totals cover 00:00-23:59:59 UTC (05:30 IST to 05:29 IST next day)
Historical observations only; not a forecast and not an official warning
Clipped to the AOI bounding box, not the official Chennai boundary (boundary dataset pending, ADR-0003)

processing_configuration.accumulation: sum of consecutive UTC daily totals; a cell missing on any day stays missing
processing_configuration.window: whole 0.1 degree cells intersecting the bbox; no resampling or interpolation
processing_configuration.grid_validation: check_axis: dtype-aware tolerance, monotonic, regular, bounded

data_kind: satellite precipitation estimate (not gauge observations); rainfall accumulation, not flood depth
